remarks: Townhouse-style condo in the desirable Villager Pond community offering a prime Darien location and thoughtful updates. The inviting living room with fireplace flows into the dining area and kitchen, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom features a vaulted ceiling, generous closet space, plus attic and crawl-space storage. Enjoy a private outdoor patio and the rare convenience of an attached one-car garage with interior access. Recent upgrades include a renovated upstairs bath, new windows, water heater, and refrigerator. Community amenities include a pool and clubhouse. Located in a coastal town with access to local beaches, along with recent additions of in-town shopping and dining, plus proximity to a movie theater, Whole Foods, Cherry Lawn Park, Trader Joe's, downtown Darien, and the Metro-North station.
